title: Encoder-Sharing Hierarchical Federated Multi-Task Learning for VANETs
abstract: arXiv:2609.36157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most federated learning frameworks for vehicular ad hoc networks assume that all vehicles collaboratively train a single model for a common task. This assumption limits their applicability to practical vehicular environments, where vehicles may perform heterogeneous but related perception tasks with different output spaces. This paper proposes encoder-sharing hierarchical multi-task federated learning (EN-HMTFL), which integrates cluster-based hierarchical federated learning with a globally shared encoder and vehicle-local decoders. EN-HMTFL enables vehicles performing different tasks to collaboratively learn a transferable feature representation while preserving their task-specific models locally. Only the encoder is exchanged and aggregated through the hierarchy, whereas raw data and local decoder parameters remain at the vehicles. The proposed framework is evaluated on the MNIST and GTSRB datasets in different vehicular scenarios. A

translated_title: 面向车载自组织网络的编码器共享分层联邦多任务学习
translated_abstract: 大多数面向车载自组织网络（VANETs）的联邦学习框架都假设所有车辆协同训练一个用于共同任务的单一模型。这一假设限制了其在实际车载环境中的适用性，因为在实际环境中，车辆可能执行输出空间不同但相互关联的异构感知任务。本文提出了编码器共享分层多任务联邦学习（EN-HMTFL），该方法将基于分簇的分层联邦学习与全局共享的编码器和车辆本地解码器相结合。EN-HMTFL使执行不同任务的车辆能够在本地保留各自任务特定模型的同时，协同学习可迁移的特征表示。只有编码器通过层次结构进行交换和聚合，而原始数据和本地解码器参数则保留在车辆端。该框架在MNIST和GTSRB数据集上的不同车载场景中进行了评估。
tldr: 提出了一种编码器共享的分层多任务联邦学习框架EN-HMTFL，通过全局共享编码器与本地解码器的解耦设计，使车联网中执行异构任务的车辆能够协同学习可迁移的特征表示，同时保护原始数据和任务特定模型的隐私。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EN-HMTFL, an encoder-sharing hierarchical federated multi-task learning framework that enables vehicles with heterogeneous perception tasks in VANETs to collaboratively learn transferable feature representations through a globally shared encoder, while keeping raw data and task-specific decoders local for privacy preservation.
